articles.summary: CONWAY, Ark., Jan. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Home BancShares, Inc. (NYSE: HOMB), parent company of Centennial Bank, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a regular $0.21 per share quarterly cash dividend payable March 4, 2026, to shareholders of record February 11, 2026. This cash dividend is consistent with the dividend paid during the fourth quarter of 2025. Home BancShares, Inc. is a bank holding company, headquartered in Conway, Arkansas. Its wholly-owned subsidiary, Centennial Bank, provides a broad range of commercial and retail banking plus related financial services to businesses, real estate developers, investors, individuals and municipalities. Centennial Bank has branch locations in Arkansas, Florida, Texas, South Alabama and New York City.
